$comment: Scheduling lives in data, not in the scheduler. The Windows task reads this file before it fetches anything. Change the cadence or pause the agent by editing a value here; nothing needs registering again. lookbackDays overrides the registry default. dailyDraftLimit and maxDraftsPerRun cap what one Claude run may write into editorial/news/drafts. minDaysBetweenSweeps is the gate the runner checks against the last successful run in runs.json (0 means every day). The cadence itself is the three day trigger in editorial/scripts/register-tasks.ps1; the gate here is a floor under it, kept one day short of the interval so ordinary scheduling jitter cannot make a scheduled sweep fall through it, and so a run started by hand or by the dashboard the day after a sweep does not crawl the same listing pages again. A forced run ignores it.
